reference_sql:
WITH per_store AS (SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' GROUP BY s.store_code),
avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(n_orders) AS avg_orders FROM per_store)
SELECT p.store_code, p.n_orders, ROUND(p.n_orders - a.avg_orders, 1) AS vs_avg
FROM per_store p
CROSS JOIN avg_all a

solver.query:
WITH per_store AS (
  SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY s.store_code
)
SELECT store_code, n_orders, ROUND(n_orders - AVG(n_orders) OVER (), 1) AS vs_avg
FROM per_store
